items.period: Shuowen seal-script style; the file is a modern 2007 vector redraw and does not identify a specific dated artifact
items.tradition: Small seal script / Shuowen seal-script style
items.caption: A modern redraw of 女 in Shuowen seal-script style. It provides a seal-style comparison for the graph, whose earlier forms are interpreted as a kneeling or seated woman.
items.alt: A single black seal-script form of 女 centered on a white square.
items.selection_reason: The visible form is legible and matches the source’s identification as 女 in Shuowen seal-script style. It offers a useful comparison with the cited descriptions of early inscription forms, without implying a direct artifact or a dated specimen.
items.rights: Public domain according to the Commons file description; attribution is not required but appreciated. Commons’ linked agreement records acknowledgment of the Richard Sears model for SVG redraws.

limitations.text: This is a modern redraw, not an image of an ancient artifact. The cited accounts describe early 女 forms as kneeling or seated figures, but differ on the hands’ position; this seal-style image alone does not show those early forms or establish a precise date.
